component.name: Airclone
component.summary: Browse, transfer and sync your cloud storage

description.p: Airclone is a file manager for cloud storage. It connects straight from your computer to the storage accounts you tell it about — Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, SFTP, WebDAV and dozens more — and lets you browse them, copy files between them, and keep folders backed up.
It is a graphical front end for rclone, and the rclone engine is built in, so there is no command line and nothing else to install.

ul.li: Browse every remote like a local folder, with two panes side by side
Copy or move files directly between two clouds
Copy, move, sync or two-way sync, with a dry run that shows exactly what would change
Back up a folder on a schedule, keeping replaced files as versions you can restore
Image and video thumbnails over any remote, cached encrypted on your device
Nothing is overwritten silently — every collision asks first

description.p: There is no Airclone account and no server of ours involved. You sign in to your own storage providers, those connections stay on your device, and every transfer runs between your device and the provider.
Fixes a freeze when scrolling a folder containing many photos or videos, and adds this Linux package.
